_doc: 人工复核改稿（docs/276 §8）：键 = 中文原文，覆盖模型初稿；csv 来源记「人改」。note 写改动原因或待用户定的点

格挡.note: 官方 Block 是「阻挡」，这里是格挡

爆发.note: 原稿 Nuker 是玩家俗称，标签用 Burst DMG

开辟.note: 乌尔比安三技能「必须开辟的通路」状态名

出身地.note: 档案栏位，定宽格子用短词

队长生命低于 40%，或神经损伤达到 80%.en: Leader's HP below 40%, or Nervous Impairment at 80%

队长神经损伤达到 60%，或灯火暗淡.en: Leader's Nervous Impairment at 60%, or Light is Dim

队长一次受到最大生命 10% 以上的伤害.en: Leader takes over 10% Max HP in one hit

队长短时间内连续被近战命中，或被敌人围住.en: Leader is hit by melee several times in a row, or is surrounded

屏幕内多名敌人浮空或眩晕.en: Several on-screen enemies are Levitated or Stunned

屏幕内多名普通敌人生命低于 30%.en: Several on-screen normal enemies below 30% HP

屏幕内远离队长处出现精英或远程敌人.en: An Elite or ranged enemy appears on screen far from the Leader

精英开始读招.en: An Elite starts winding up an attack

另一名队友的连携亮起时（抢在它出手前）.en: Another squad member's Link lights up (acts before it does)

另一名队友的连携命中后.en: After another squad member's Link hits

另一名队友的连携命中、附近敌人聚成一团时.en: Another squad member's Link hits and nearby enemies are bunched up

终焉句点.note: 逻各斯，「句点」保留标点的双关

罗德岛辅助干员、信使安洁莉娜，用自己奇妙的源石技艺为你提供协助.en: Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, helps you out with her amazing Originium Arts.
罗德岛辅助干员、信使安洁莉娜，用自己奇妙的源石技艺为你提供协助.note: 改写自官方招聘合同 char_291_aglina.itemUsage（原句是 would like to provide help）；候选2：Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, here to help with her amazing Originium Arts.

火山学家，天灾信使。在战场上，她的法术是最可靠的决战力量.en: Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. On the battlefield, her Arts are the force you can count on to win.
火山学家，天灾信使。在战场上，她的法术是最可靠的决战力量.note: 候选2：Volcanologist and Catastrophe Messenger. On the battlefield, her Arts are your most reliable trump card.

阿戈尔技术执政官、荣誉军团长，阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”总战争设计师之一.en: Ægir Consul of Technology, Honorary Legion Commander, and one of the chief war designers of the Ægir military group, the Abyssal Hunters.
阿戈尔技术执政官、荣誉军团长，阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”总战争设计师之一.note: 头衔词序未在官方英文档案里逐一核对，第二步核 handbook_info_table；候选2：Consul of Technology of Ægir, honorary Legion Commander, one of the chief war architects of the Abyssal Hunters.

龙门近卫局特别任务组精英干员，害怕的时候可以站在她身边壮胆.en: Elite Operator of the Special Service of the Lungmen Guard Department. Stand by her side when you are scared. It really helps.
龙门近卫局特别任务组精英干员，害怕的时候可以站在她身边壮胆.note: 第二句是官方 char_136_hsguma.itemDesc 原文

面对邪教徒和海嗣时，她手中细剑绝对不会姑息任何一个敌人.en: Against cultists and Seaborn, the rapier in her hand spares no one.
面对邪教徒和海嗣时，她手中细剑绝对不会姑息任何一个敌人.note: 候选2：When she faces cultists and Seaborn, her rapier shows no mercy to a single enemy.

这片大地的代言人（划掉）.en: The voice of this land (crossed out)

她是落单的狼，现作为近卫干员，于战术攻坚与肃清作战中展现出十足的歼灭能力.en: A lone wolf. Now a Guard Operator, she shows full annihilation capability in tactical assaults and mop-up operations.
她是落单的狼，现作为近卫干员，于战术攻坚与肃清作战中展现出十足的歼灭能力.note: 候选2：She is a wolf without a pack. As a Guard Operator, she excels at breaching and clearing operations.

女妖河谷年轻的「女主人」，罗德岛圆凳滑行赛组织创始人.en: The young 'Lady' of the Banshee Valley, organizer of Rhodes Island's stool racing competition.
女妖河谷年轻的「女主人」，罗德岛圆凳滑行赛组织创始人.note: 「圆凳滑行赛」出自档案资料三，en_US handbook_info_table 原文 the stool racing competition…Logos organized that；原作只说组织，不说创始人。「女主人」暂定 'Lady'，保留引号（协调人 11-05 暂定）

无论是什么身份，他始终只是竭尽自己所能，为同伴提供支持和援助.en: Whatever his title, he simply does all he can to support and aid his companions.
无论是什么身份，他始终只是竭尽自己所能，为同伴提供支持和援助.note: 候选2：No matter who he is meant to be, he always does his utmost to support his companions.

这就是你的选择吗？他或许想要一个锚点来固定住自己，他会紧紧抓牢你.en: So this is your choice? He may want an anchor with which to fix himself, and he'll have you tight in his clutches when he does.

所有人都知道塞雷娅站在战场上意味着什么，把后背交给她，然后，向前进吧。.en: Everyone knows what it means when Saria takes the field. Leave your back to her, and move forward.
所有人都知道塞雷娅站在战场上意味着什么，把后背交给她，然后，向前进吧。.note: 候选2：Everyone knows what Saria on the battlefield means. Trust her with your back, then advance.

“举起大锤，领着大伙，毫不畏惧地冲锋”，对她来说，这些一直都是理所当然的事情。.en: 'Lead from the front, charging fearlessly into the fray with the hammer.' To her, it has always been her nature.
“举起大锤，领着大伙，毫不畏惧地冲锋”，对她来说，这些一直都是理所当然的事情。.note: 出处：悖论模拟「头阵冲锋」关卡简介（handbook_info_table.handbookStageData.char_112_siege，mem_siege_1，en 关卡名 Heading the Charge）。en_US 原表是意译，没有引号句，原文：From the streets to the battlefield, it has always been her nature to lead from the front, charging fearlessly into the fray with her hammer. 这里按官方措辞改写。wiki.gg 引的 Bring the hammer out, bring the gang in, charge without fear 在 en_US 原表里查不到

前阿戈尔传奇电工，能够以一己之力维护一整座城市的海底灯光阵列.en: Former legendary Ægir electrician, able to maintain an entire city's undersea lighting array single-handedly.

名为斯卡蒂的深海猎人//名为伊莎玛拉的海嗣\n正停留此处\n等待你的部署//渴盼.en:
The Abyssal Hunter named Skadi // The Seaborn named Ishar'mla
waits here
for your deployment // for your call
名为斯卡蒂的深海猎人//名为伊莎玛拉的海嗣\n正停留此处\n等待你的部署//渴盼.note:
伊莎玛拉官方拼写 Ishar'mla（初稿写成 Ishar-mla）；保留 // 双声部排版。候选2：An Abyssal Hunter called Skadi // A Seaborn called Ishar'mla
lingers here
awaiting your orders // longing for your call

本名劳伦缇娜，自囚笼里挣脱，从疯狂中苏醒。.en: Born Laurentina, free from her cage, awake from her madness.
本名劳伦缇娜，自囚笼里挣脱，从疯狂中苏醒。.note: 后半句是官方 char_1023_ghost2.itemUsage 原文；候选2：Laurentina by birth. Free from her cage, awake from her madness.

罗德岛干员铃兰，九倍的温柔与坚强。她是罗德岛的光.en: Suzuran, Rhodes Island Operator, has nine times the strength, and the fluffiness. She is the light of Rhodes Island.
罗德岛干员铃兰，九倍的温柔与坚强。她是罗德岛的光.note: 前句是官方 char_358_lisa.itemUsage 原文；后句是玩家梗，英文社区有 she is our light 的说法，暂定直译（协调人 11-05 暂定）

企鹅物流员工，虽然平时沉默寡言，但战斗风格却可以用“暴风骤雨”来形容。.en: Penguin Logistics employee. Usually a woman of few words, but her fighting style is best described as a 'torrential storm'.
企鹅物流员工，虽然平时沉默寡言，但战斗风格却可以用“暴风骤雨”来形容。.note: 「暴风骤雨」呼应她的技能「剑雨」，英文用 storm 保留；候选2：... her fighting style can only be called a downpour of blades.

阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”作战指挥官之一。他独行，一如他刚成为深海猎人时那样。.en: One of the field commanders of the Ægir military group, the Abyssal Hunters. He walks alone, just as when he first became an Abyssal Hunter.
阿戈尔军事团体“深海猎人”作战指挥官之一。他独行，一如他刚成为深海猎人时那样。.note: 第二句是官方 char_4145_ulpia.itemDesc 原文

「惊跳反射」使「唤醒」的强化攻击追加触手攻击；「病理性依恋」使被触手拖到身边的敌.en: 'Startle Reflex' causes the enhanced attack of 'Awaken' to deal an additional tentacle attack; 'Pathological Attachment' causes enemies dragged to him by tentacles to be entangled.

解锁二技能「跃空锤」；解锁天赋「鼓舞」：锤击命中时为其他干员回复的技力翻倍；普攻.en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Aerial Hammer'; Unlocks Talent 'Rally': Doubles SP restored to other Operators when hammer strikes hit; Normal attack 'Crushing': When a hammer strike defeats an enemy, debris bursts forth, dealing {$crush_mult*100}% of hammer strike damage to enemies within a radius of {$crush_r} (up to {$crush_cap} bursts per hammer strike)
解锁二技能「跃空锤」；解锁天赋「鼓舞」：锤击命中时为其他干员回复的技力翻倍；普攻.note: 天赋「鼓舞」暂定 Rally（避开官方状态词 Inspiration）

解锁三技能「必须开辟的通路」：掷锚冲锋，沿途与落点都造成伤害、落点眩晕一片，之后.en: Unlocks Skill 3 'Paths Must Be Opened': throws the anchor and dashes, dealing damage along the path and at the target location, Stunning enemies at the target location, then accelerating Anchor Strike for {$s3_haste}s. Earthshake range expands to {$quake_r_e2}, damage increases to {$quake_mult_e2*100}%. Normal attack enhanced to 'Cast Anchor': every {$throw_n}th Anchor Strike instead throws the anchor at the furthest enemy beyond {$throw_min} (or the nearest if none), dealing ×{$throw_mult} Anchor Strike damage upon landing, then dragging enemies along the chain back to himself, dealing an additional {$throw_back*100}% damage (dragging Bosses excepted).

天赋「指挥」治疗量提升至 +{$e2_heal*100-100}%；解锁三技能「.en: Talent 'Command' healing increased to +{$e2_heal*100-100}%; unlocks Skill 3 'Command: Meltdown': Mon3tr's claw attacks deal True damage and damage is multiplied by {$s3_mult*$k_pow:2} for {$s3_dur}s; upon ending, melts down: deals True damage equal to {$melt_mult*$k_pow:2} times ATK to enemies within a radius of {$melt_r}; Normal attack enhancement 'Omnidirectional Deployment': Mon3tr attacks with claws to the front and back simultaneously (the backward claw deals {$m_back_mult*100}% damage); 'Fall Back': When the Leader is attacked, Mon3tr leaps back to the Leader, dealing {$leap_mult} times damage to enemies within a radius of {$leap_r} and causing knockback (at most once every {$guard_cd}s); 'Non-Damaging Restructuring': When Mon3tr falls, it explodes on the spot, dealing True damage equal to {$rebuild_mult} times ATK to enemies within a radius of {$rebuild_r} and Stuns them for {$rebuild_stun}s.

解锁二技能「冲锋号令·γ型」；解锁天赋「战术快递」：队长每次冲刺，她同向冲刺一次.en: Unlocks Skill 2 'Charge γ'. Unlocks Talent 'Tactical Delivery': Whenever the Leader dashes, she dashes once in the same direction; passing through enemies restores SP to all squad members, and each Sword Draw attack restores a small amount of SP. Basic attack upgraded to 'Pinning Sword': Enemies Blocked are each pierced by an Originium sword, extending the immobilization time to {$pin_dur}s (halved on Elites, Bosses excepted).
